description.zh: 需配置的Group ID所对应的实例ID。
description.en: The ID of the instance to which the group ID belongs.

description.zh:
设置Group ID对应的消费者集群是否有读取消息权限。取值说明如下：

- **true**：指定Group ID对应的消费者集群有读消息权限。

- **false**：指定Group ID对应的消费者集群没有读消息权限。

默认值为**true**。
description.en:
Specifies whether the consumer cluster for the group ID has permission to read messages. Valid values:

- **true**: The consumer cluster has permission to read messages.

- **false**: The consumer cluster does not have permission to read messages.

Default value: **true**.

title.zh: 配置消费集群的消息读取权限

descriptions.zh: ><notice>阿里云提供的OpenAPI属于管控类API，用于管理和查询阿里云服务的相关资源。仅推荐在管控链路集成，消息收发的核心数据链路中严禁依赖OpenAPI实现，否则可能会导致链路产生风险。></notice>
descriptions.en:
><notice>

Alibaba Cloud OpenAPI is a control-plane API used to manage and query Alibaba Cloud service resources. Integrate OpenAPI only on the control plane. Do not depend on OpenAPI for core data links that send and receive messages. This can introduce threats to your data links.

></notice>

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ons ons-group-consumer-update --group-id GID_test_groupId --read-enable true --instance-id MQ_INST_111111111111_DOxxxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ons OnsGroupConsumerUpdate --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId MQ_INST_111111111111_DOxxxxxx --ReadEnable true --GroupId GID_test_groupId
